pages.text: Nell spots a bit of cake on the path.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee noticing a small bit of cake lying on the garden path.

pages.text: Nell wants to take it back.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering over the bit of cake, deciding to carry it home.
Pip the sparrow landing beside Nell and the bit of cake.
Moss the hedgehog trotting over to see what Nell and Pip have found.
Close view of the small bit of cake on the path, hardly bigger than a crumb.

pages.text: Nell can not take it all for herself.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee looking from the small cake to Pip and Moss.

pages.text: Nell cuts the cake into bits.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee carefully dividing the small cake into three bits.

pages.text: Nell sets a bit for Pip.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee setting one bit of cake in front of Pip.

pages.text: Nell sets a bit for Moss.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee setting another bit of cake in front of Moss.

pages.text: Pip, Moss and Nell eat the cake at the gate.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow, Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee all eating their bits of cake together by the garden gate.
